Independent check: The semi-major and semi-minor axes are 13 and 5. Thus c = √(13² − 5²) = 12, so e = c/a = 12/13.
solution:
For an ellipse, $e=\dfrac{c}{a}$, where $c^2=a^2-b^2$. Here $a=13$ and $b=5$.
$$c=\sqrt{13^2-5^2}=12,\qquad e=\frac{12}{13}$$
